title: Scalable Microservices Platform & Real-Time Energy Telemetry
subtitle: Distributed microservices architecture with Spring Boot, RabbitMQ & Reverse Proxy Load Balancing
summary: A high-performance fullstack microservices platform designed for real-time sensor data ingestion, RabbitMQ message queuing, and reverse proxy load-balanced processing.
description: Architected for high scalability and real-time interaction in distributed enterprise environments. The system ingests continuous sensor data streams, distributes asynchronous message pipelines via RabbitMQ brokers, routes traffic through a reverse proxy with load balancing, and persists transactional state across Spring Boot backend services and MySQL. Features real-time WebSockets synchronization, Docker containerization, and responsive React monitoring dashboards.

impactMetrics.description: Decoupled asynchronous message broker ensuring zero packet drop.

impactMetrics.label: Traffic Routing
impactMetrics.description: Reverse proxy distributing client requests evenly across backend nodes.

impactMetrics.label: Reliability
impactMetrics.description: Resilient failover and low-latency WebSockets state streaming.

title: dotPass — Zero-Knowledge Secure Password Manager & Intrusion Shield
subtitle: Python desktop security vault with PBKDF2 key derivation, AES-256 encryption & HaveIBeenPwned k-Anonymity API
summary: A zero-knowledge cryptographic vault written in Python. Protects master credentials via salted PBKDF2 HMAC-SHA256, encrypts vault data via AES-256, checks breach status via HaveIBeenPwned k-Anonymity API, and sends real-time intrusion alerts.
description: Engineered as an authentic high-security personal credential manager. Implements a strictly zero-knowledge architecture where the master password is never stored or transmitted. Symmetric AES-256 encryption keys are derived on-the-fly using 100,000+ PBKDF2 iterations with unique per-user cryptographic salts. Incorporates HaveIBeenPwned SHA-1 5-character prefix queries to detect pwned credentials with mathematical anonymity, and external API alerting for suspicious login attempts with SMS/geolocation warnings.

impactMetrics.label: Key Derivation
impactMetrics.description: Brute-force resistant memory-hard key derivation with per-user salt.

impactMetrics.label: Encryption
impactMetrics.description: Zero-knowledge authenticated credential storage in encrypted SQLite vault.

impactMetrics.label: Breach Verification
impactMetrics.description: Zero plaintext leakage via 5-character SHA-1 prefix API checks.

title: Multithreaded Task Queue & Concurrency Management Engine
subtitle: High-throughput asynchronous task scheduler using Java concurrency primitives
summary: A core multithreaded queuing engine engineered to balance dynamic task loads across dedicated worker threads without bottlenecks or thread starvation.
description: Built to tackle asynchronous workload distribution and synchronization challenges in compute-heavy systems. Employs Java's concurrency utilities (thread pools, blocking queues, atomic operations) to dynamically allocate and execute bursty task streams. Features real-time queue depth monitoring, simulation modes, and deadlock-free synchronization.

impactMetrics.description: Fair distribution algorithms prevent low-priority task starvation.

title: API Intercepts & Resilient UI Test Automation Harness
subtitle: Advanced Cypress test suite simulating edge-case network payloads and backend failures
summary: A robust frontend test automation harness utilizing Cypress cy.intercept() to validate client-side fault tolerance against faulty or degraded APIs.
description: Created to verify that modern web applications gracefully handle backend chaos. By intercepting HTTP network traffic and dynamically injecting custom HTTP status codes (404, 500, 503), malformed JSON, and synthetic network latency, the suite ensures UI interfaces display proper user-friendly fallbacks without unhandled exceptions or broken layouts.

impactMetrics.description: All critical HTTP error scenarios and timeout states verified.

impactMetrics.label: Regression Speed
impactMetrics.description: Fast headless test execution integrated into development workflows.

impactMetrics.label: UI Crash Prevention
impactMetrics.description: Ensures clean toast/modal feedback on every network failure.

title: Native Hardware Benchmarking & Thermal Telemetry Suite
subtitle: Low-level C++ benchmarking utility measuring CPU throughput, network latency, and SSD I/O
